# Combobox

A text field that suggests and completes matches from a known list as people type.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-combobox--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:light" title="Combobox examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-combobox--docs">Open Combobox in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-combobox--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** Picks an asset or a user from thousands.

- **Use it when:** A long, closed list: countries, addresses, people, tags.
- **Not when:** Searching a whole site, or a short list people can see at once.

Instead:

- [Select](./select.md): A compact closed list without typing.
- [Command](./command.md): A search-first menu of actions.

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move through suggestions; Enter picks; Escape closes. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a combobox; the open state and the active option are announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add combobox
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Combobox reads 1 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Combobox's tokens to change Combobox alone.
